speaker: Doctor
text: Let's start with your age and sex, and how long you have been experiencing this chronic cough. Have you noticed any blood in your sputum, or changes in the color of your phlegm?

speaker: Patient
text: 68-year-old male. The patient reports having a fever, cough, weakness, night sweats, and poor appetite persisting for 6 months. He has lost 7.5 kg (16.5 lb) over this period. No history of breathlessness, nasal discharge, nasal obstruction, palpitations, chest pain, or digestive symptoms. Released from prison 9 months ago after a 2-year sentence.

speaker: Doctor
text: That significant weight loss combined with night sweats and a six-month cough is very concerning; could you tell me if you have had any close contact with someone known to have tuberculosis, or if you have traveled recently? Also, have you experienced any urinary symptoms or unintentional pain in your back or ribs?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Chronic cough and fever. I also have Weight loss, Night sweats, Generalized weakness, Poor appetite.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Tuberculosis.

REQUEST TEST: Sputum_Acid_Fast_Stain and Culture.
REQUEST IMAGES: Chest_X-Ray.
